description_expanded: ABOUT COLE BIN: Cole Bin is a single-story residence that offers a private entrance, convenient street parking, a fenced yard suitable for pets, and a spacious deck for outdoor relaxation. Upon arrival, guests are greeted by a generously sized living room equipped with amenities including a pool table, television, sleeper sofa, and ample seating. Positioned to the right of the living space, the first bedroom features a queen bed and a twin bed, with direct access to a nearby hallway bathroom. Progressing through the living room, one will find a sizable dining area and an adjacent laundry room that flows seamlessly into the well-equipped kitchen and sunlit Florida room. Situated to the left of the dining area, a second bedroom is furnished with two queen beds and a twin bed, sharing a conveniently located hallway bathroom. The Florida room leads to a lavish master bedroom with a king-sized bed and a luxurious en suite bathroom. ABOUT THE AREA: Grayton Beach is a charming coastal community located along Scenic Highway 30A in the Florida Panhandle. Known for its stunning white sandy beaches and crystal-clear emerald waters, Grayton Beach offers a serene and picturesque setting for visitors to unwind and enjoy the natural beauty of the Gulf Coast. The area is home to the Grayton Beach State Park, which boasts hiking trails, coastal dune lakes, and diverse ecosystems that are perfect for outdoor enthusiasts and nature lovers. The town itself features eclectic art galleries, local shops, and delicious dining options, making it a popular destination for those seeking a laid-back beach experience with a touch of Southern charm. Grayton Beach's relaxed atmosphere and pristine surroundings make it a beloved hidden gem along the scenic 30A corridor. BEACH ACCESS: * Grayton beach public beach access PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS: * 1 minute walk to downtown Grayton Beach * Short walk to the beach PARKING: * Free Parking up to 2 Vehicles PROPERTY RULES: * Must sign rental agreement within 48 hrs of booking or subject to cancellation * If you choose to bring your dog/s, there is an additional, non-refundable pet fee of $250 per dog. The fee is to be charged after reservation confirmation. * Must Be 25 years or older ABOUT PARADISE PROPERTIES: When you book your vacation in Florida's Panhandle, with Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals and Sales, you can expect first class customer service from the moment you inquire. All of our properties are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained at the highest level. We are located close to all of our properties and we are available 24 hours per day and 7 days per week to ensure your vacation is flawless. Our goal is to build lasting memories for all guests.

Location: Less Than a 5 Minute Walk to the Beach
